column1: # EA SPORTS FC 27 (Frostbite 2025.1.2), SDK 22.2.0, NVN in the renderer NRO Engine.Render.Core2.PlatformNvn.nro.
# Started from the NSP script's provisional profile; the memory layout is measured on the Mac (README.md, Memory).
# 1.8d.6523 is the update this folder holds; the 1.8d.310c row stays so the host still knows that build's frame regulator. The shader tables are made from
# 1.8d.6523's files (7,875 shaders), and listed versions must all be present in the NSP folder, so only v458752 is listed.
# every module main imports from (the renderer NRO is loaded at run time, nro_collect.py)
# The NPDM declares 6 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main sets a heap of 1.19 GB (a 1.25 GB heap region, the heap check). Frostbite's VirtualAlloc reserves its
# arenas as address regions, 264 of them and 2.8 GB in its first minute while it maps 0.7 GB: after the 62 MB node area they reach alias +3.5 GB at the title and +4.5 GB
# 67 minutes into a match, so the alias region is 5.25 GB in a 7 GB block (README.md, Memory; more than the 5 GB proven on an iPhone)
# the NPDM declares 6 MB of system resource
# native swapchain size the launcher offers (720p / 1080p / 1440p / 4K); the NRO patch forces it at run time
# The registered build selects near-zero NVN depth (the NSP script's region check, 2026-10-29: one nvnDeviceSetDepthMode call, near = 0); offline pipeline bases use main0_z.

column1: # The renderer keeps one copy of each control section by a hash that leaves out GLSLC's compile information (+0x7d0..+0x7e7) and hands later shaders the first one, so at run time
# those bytes name another shader (README.md, Shaders)
# 60 fps as on the game's other platforms: the host sets Frostbite's simulation rate (SimulationTimeSettings, found by name) and, on 1.8d.310c and 1.8d.6523, the game's frame
# regulator to the target (hle_fpslock.c); the game asks for present interval 2, which display pacing ignores (README.md, Frame rate). 30 runs the game's own 30
# 120 is offered in the launcher: the regulator and Frostbite's simulation rate follow it; the present runs at 120 Hz on a 120 Hz display link (hle_fpslock.c, hle_nvn.c)
